title: Atul Narain v. S.D.O. Vidyut Vitran
coram: Arun Tandon, J.; Sunita Agarwal, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; petitioner relegated to civil suit or Annexure 4.2.
headnote: Writ for a meter in the petitioner's own name in premises over which he had already filed a civil suit claiming a share, disposed of by relegating him to an application in that suit or to the Executive Engineer under Annexure 4.2 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Atul Narain petitioned the Allahabad High Court for a direction to install an electricity meter in his own name in the premises in question. He had already filed a civil suit claiming a share in that property. The respondents were the Sub-Divisional Officer, Vidyut Vitran, and another. The Division Bench recorded the pending title claim and did not examine whether a connection or meter was due on the facts of occupation or ownership.

holding_units.topic: meter in own name — pending title suit
holding_units.holding: Where the petitioner has already filed a civil suit claiming a share in the property, a writ seeking installation of a meter for supply in his own name is disposed of without a merits direction; he may apply in the pending suit or approach the Executive Engineer under Annexure 4.2 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Entitlement to a meter for supply in the petitioner's own name in the premises
not_decided.note: Left to an application in the pending civil suit or to the Executive Engineer under Annexure 4.2
